reason: The 45-gene expression signature was measured in patient cohorts, but histone acetylation changes from the identified compounds were assayed only in HCC cell lines, not in the human samples.
DNA methylation at cg05575921/AHRR and cg03636183/F2RL3 was measured in blood from four prospective case-control cohorts and linked to smoking exposure and lung cancer risk.

Methylation inhibitors and histone deacetylation effects on alloantigen presentation were tested in a Raji cell-based assay; no epigenetic mark was directly measured in the patient samples themselves.
IGF-1, IGF-1R and IGFBP-3 promoter methylation were measured by MSP in peripheral blood of esophageal carcinoma cases versus healthy controls and linked to prognosis.
Sera DNA methylation of CDH1, DNMT3b and ESR1 promoters was measured by MSP in a case-control series and evaluated as an early-diagnosis biomarker for HBV-related HCC.
MGMT promoter methylation status was measured to select the unmethylated-glioblastoma population for this randomised trial, directly linking the marker to treatment-selection strategy.
Genome-wide CpG-SNP methylation was directly measured by MBD-seq in blood and postmortem brain in a schizophrenia case-control MWAS.
Mitochondrial DNA methylation (MT-TF, MT-RNR1) was measured in blood of chromium-exposed workers versus matched controls, linking methylation to occupational Cr exposure.
DNA methylation age (epigenetic clock, IEAA/EEAA) was measured in blood in a Parkinson's disease case-control comparison.
Placental DNA methylation at INHBA/FN1/PAPPA was measured and correlated with maternal serum protein levels and birth outcomes in a cohort of term placentas.
Sperm DNA fragmentation, bulky adducts and 8-oxo-dGuo were measured via TUNEL/SCSA, which assess DNA strand damage rather than a regulatory epigenetic mark.
Epigenome-wide DNA methylation (Infinium 450K) was measured in placenta, umbilical artery and HUVEC in a birth cohort and linked to in utero arsenic exposure.
MBD sequencing and MSP directly measured tumor DNA methylation in a large neuroblastoma cohort to build a prognostic methylation signature.
H3K27me3 loss was assessed by immunohistochemistry on tumor tissue across a cohort of MPNSTs and comparator tumors as a diagnostic marker.
Genome-wide blood DNA methylation (Illumina 450K) was measured in an EWAS and a CpG in TXNIP was linked to prevalent type 2 diabetes and HbA1c.
HDAC activity and NF-κB activation were measured in a macrophage-like cell line; the epigenetic marker was not measured in the patients' own alveolar macrophages (only cytokine release was).
Telomere length and CDKN2A DNA methylation were measured in blood of hairdressers versus non-hairdressers in a cross-sectional study linked to occupational hair-product exposure.
This is a birth-cohort protocol/rationale paper describing planned recruitment and future epigenetic analysis; no primary data are reported.
SEPT9 promoter methylation was measured in peripheral blood of FOBT-positive subjects and linked to colorectal cancer screening/diagnosis.
Only histone H3.3K27M/G34R mutation status was tested in 3 tumor samples (a genetic mutation, not a directly measured methylation/histone mark); the trial otherwise assessed bevacizumab efficacy.
Increased H3K4 trimethylation was directly measured in bladder cancer tissue and cells alongside MLL mutation status, linked to recurrence and prognosis.
This is a phase I PK/safety trial of the HDAC inhibitor vorinostat plus bortezomib; no epigenetic marker was measured in participants.
Biological age was predicted from circulating plasma protein abundance; no DNA methylation or other epigenetic mark was directly measured.
MGMT promoter methylation and DNA damage signalling were assessed in glioblastoma patient-derived xenografts grown in mice, not in human participants directly.
This cross-sectional study of tooth eruption and walking age has no epigenetic marker measured at all.
Cord-blood-associated DNA methylation at 26 CpGs was measured in children aged 3-5 and used to classify prenatal cigarette smoke exposure.
CpG island methylator phenotype (CIMP) status was measured in tumor tissue and tested for association with survival alongside dietary exposure in this CRC cohort.
Genome-wide DNA methylation (Illumina 450K) was measured in lung adenocarcinoma tissue and used to build a prognostic index validated in an independent TCGA cohort.
This study measures autoantibody reactivity against DNA-loaded nucleosomes by ELISA in lupus nephritis; no epigenetic mark is directly measured.
DNA methylation age (DNAm age) was estimated from blood in a longitudinal twin cohort and linked to mortality risk.
EZH2 protein expression was assessed by immunohistochemistry in pituitary adenomas; this measures the regulator's expression level, not a histone mark or methylation state directly.
HDAC1 protein overexpression was assessed by immunohistochemistry in laryngeal carcinoma; enzyme expression level was measured, not a histone modification itself.
PTEN promoter methylation was measured by methylation-specific PCR in gallbladder cancer tissue and linked to disease occurrence/development, alongside mutation and expression analysis.
Longitudinal DNA methylation in offspring blood at birth, age 7 and 17 was measured and modelled against sustained maternal smoking in pregnancy.
CpG island methylator phenotype and LINE-1 tumor methylation were measured in this CRC cohort and included as covariates in the physical-activity/survival association model.

This study assesses temporal stability of tumor methylation markers across paired biopsies; it does not relate the marker to a modifiable exposure or a clinical decision, only to measurement reproducibility.
This study examines the MTHFR C677T genetic polymorphism and histopathological features in CRC; no epigenetic marker (methylation/histone mark) was measured.
D4Z4 CpG methylation was measured in patients with FSHD1 and linked to disease severity in a cross-sectional observational cohort.
SETD2 and H3K36me3 (a histone modification) were assessed by immunohistochemistry in a cohort of 192 ccRCC patients and linked to recurrence/survival.
Genome-wide tumor DNA methylation was measured in prostate cancer patients on androgen deprivation and linked to development of castrate-resistant disease.
DNA methylation (Infinium 450K, Horvath clock) was measured across five time points in mother-child pairs and linked to prenatal/early-life exposures.
Phosphorylated H2AX (γ-H2AX), a histone modification, was assessed by immunohistochemistry in pretreatment TNBC biopsies and linked to chemotherapy response.
γ-H2AX and 53BP1 histone foci were measured in PBMCs from rectal cancer patients in a prospective study assessing prediction of radiotherapy outcome.
EPCAM promoter methylation and CpG island methylator phenotype were measured directly in a large CRC cohort and linked to prognosis and Lynch-syndrome screening.
This is a prevalence survey of temporomandibular disorders with no epigenetic marker measured.

MLH1 promoter hypermethylation was used to classify likely-sporadic MMR-deficient cases in this screening series, but it is unclear whether methylation was analysed as an outcome within the compared LS/LL groups or the comparison design fits one of the five eligible designs.
Quantitative methylation-specific PCR measured methylation of five genes across normal, hyperplastic and cancerous endometrium in a prospective case-control diagnostic study.
DNA methylation of NDN and CD1A was measured in a prospective cohort of HNSCC patients and linked to overall survival.
HDAC1/3/6/11 and SIRT3 gene (mRNA) expression trajectories were measured in trauma patients; this is transcript expression, not a directly measured epigenetic mark.
Phosphorylated histone H3 (PHH3), a mitotic histone modification, was measured immunohistochemically in a large prostatectomy cohort and linked to prognosis.
Circulating DNA-histone complexes released by neutrophils were measured in serum of hemodialysis patients; this is a circulating protein/DNA complex biomarker, not a chromatin-state measurement.
A novel sequencing method (MCTA-Seq) measured hypermethylated CpG islands in circulating cell-free DNA of HCC patients and controls for cancer detection.
Plasma Sept9 DNA methylation was measured by a commercial PCR assay in a nested case-control CRC screening cohort.
Histone acetylation marks (H3K18ac, H3K9ac) and PBMC HDAC activity were measured in tissue and blood in a randomised sulforaphane supplementation trial.
Blood transcriptomics (gene expression) was measured in Parkinson's disease patients; epigenetic modifications are only discussed as a pathway enrichment term, not directly measured.
Genome-wide placental CpG methylation was measured and compared between preeclamptic cases and normotensive controls.
FANCF promoter methylation was measured by MSP in ovarian cancer tissue versus normal ovarian tissue and linked to susceptibility and prognosis.
Methylation of the 11p15 imprinted region was directly assayed in patients selected by clinical scoring for Silver-Russell/Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome to confirm diagnosis.
CpG-island promoter methylation of EGFL7 was measured by MSP/pyrosequencing across mesothelioma, matched non-neoplastic pleura and biopsy samples.
MGMT promoter methylation status was measured in a prospective glioblastoma registry and linked to treatment response and survival alongside IDH mutation.
This is a phase II trial of ultra-fractionated radiotherapy plus temozolomide in glioblastoma; no epigenetic marker was measured.
p15 gene CpG island methylation was quantified in bone marrow cells of childhood ALL cases versus controls and linked to event-free survival.
Sperm chromatin decondensation, DNA fragmentation and aneuploidy were measured; per the instrument these sperm chromatin-integrity endpoints are not a regulatory epigenetic mark.

NotI-microarray profiling detected DNA methylation and deletions across 33 prostate tumors, but the abstract does not clearly state a comparison group or one of the five eligible designs, reading as a bare tumor series.
Genome-wide methylation array plus validation MSP identified CLIC3 hypomethylation in a case-control comparison of MEC tumor versus matched normal tissue.
CpG island methylator phenotype was measured in tumor tissue and tested for interaction with age on CRC survival in a large prospective cohort.
Histone methyltransferase/demethylase (SMYD2, SETD3, NO66) mRNA and protein expression were measured as biomarkers; this is enzyme expression, not the histone mark itself.
DLX4 promoter methylation was quantified by qMSP/bisulfite sequencing in MDS patients versus controls and linked to overall survival.
Epigenetic age (DNAm clock) was measured in blood of nonagenarians and young controls and linked to CMV serostatus.
Gene-specific DNA methylation of DNMT3B and MTHFR was quantified in blood leukocytes of a screening colonoscopy cohort and linked to colorectal adenoma risk.
This study reports genetic mutation frequencies (BAP1, PBRM1, KDM5C) in renal cell carcinoma tumors; no methylation or histone mark was directly measured.
This is a technical comparison of two DNA-methylation detection platforms (MethylCap-seq vs HM450) assessing assay sensitivity/specificity, not a disease-marker association study.
DNA methylation (Infinium 450K) was measured in monozygotic twins discordant for childhood psychotic symptoms, linking methylation to a mental-health risk phenotype.
This study of CSF-testing guidelines in febrile infants has no epigenetic marker measured.
Serum DNA methylation of the GSTP promoter was measured by HRM analysis in an HCC case-control study linked to environmental benzo[a]pyrene exposure.
LINE-1 global methylation and GSTP1 promoter methylation were measured by pyrosequencing in a nested case-control study of prostate biopsies.
H3K4 and H3K27 trimethylation were measured in blood cells of nickel-smelting workers versus referents, linking histone methylation to occupational exposure.
This RCT of CPAP during cardiac rehabilitation exercise has no epigenetic marker measured.
EBNA1 ChIP-Seq and RNA-Seq were performed in EBV-positive cell lines (Burkitt lymphoma, NPC and lymphoblastoid cell lines), not in human participants or primary human-derived samples.
Anti-dsDNA, anti-nucleosome and anti-histone autoantibody titers were measured by ELISA in lupus nephritis; this is an antibody assay, not a directly measured epigenetic mark.
CpG island methylation status of tumors was measured and tested for association with clinical benefit from vemurafenib in this metastatic CRC trial.
FOXM1 ChIP-Seq (cistrome) was performed only in the MCF-7 cell line; the patient cohort analysis used gene/transcript expression, not epigenetic marker measurement in humans.
Histone H3.3 mutation status (a genetic alteration) was tested alongside IDH1/2 and BRAF mutations in PXA patients; no epigenetic mark was directly measured.
DNA methylation at HYAL2 CpG loci was measured and shown to predict survival on 5-FU chemotherapy in colon cancer patients.
Genome-wide sperm DNA methylation (450K array) was measured in semen samples from couples with differing time-to-conception and linked to fecundity.
Mass-spectrometry proteomics of orbital tissue measured protein expression (including histone H4 as one identified protein), not an epigenetic modification state.
Methylated BCAT1 and IKZF1 were measured in plasma cell-free DNA across a large series of colonoscopy patients as a colorectal neoplasia screening test.
HDAC2 protein expression was one of ten immunohistochemical markers assessed in pediatric tumors; this is enzyme expression, not a directly measured epigenetic mark.
A genome-wide DNA methylation panel was measured in nasopharyngeal carcinoma tissue versus non-cancer tissue and validated as a prognostic biomarker.
LINE-1 global DNA methylation was measured in blood of children with Legg-Calvé-Perthes disease versus matched controls.
Maternal and toddler FADS2 DNA methylation was measured and linked to toddlers' polyunsaturated fatty acid intake/status in a mother-child cohort.
Whole-exome and targeted sequencing identified somatic mutations in DNA-methylation/chromatin-related genes (e.g., DNMT3A) in AML; no epigenetic mark was directly measured.
γ-H2AX, a histone modification, was quantified by flow cytometry in PBMCs of breast cancer patients in this randomised short-term-fasting chemotherapy trial.
Epigenome-wide blood DNA methylation (Illumina 450K) was measured in over 1,500 older adults and linked to prevalent type 2 diabetes.
Electrophoretic mobility of cell nuclei (EMN index) was measured as a proposed aging biomarker; this is a structural/physical cell property, not an epigenetic mark.
Global DNA hypermethylation (5-methylcytosine) was measured in a randomised crossover trial of chlorella supplementation and linked to PAH exposure/detoxification.
Methylated thrombomodulin promoter (Met-TM) DNA methylation was measured in serum and combined with miR-126 and SMRP to diagnose malignant mesothelioma.
Genome-wide DNA methylation was measured in newborns with congenital heart defects versus controls for diagnostic classification.
Genome-wide tumor DNA methylation status was measured in metastatic CRC patients and linked to clinical response to anti-EGFR treatment.
Plasma cell-free DNA methylation markers were measured and evaluated for diagnostic performance distinguishing lung cancer, pulmonary fibrosis and COPD.
